data_status: ALL model training labels, paired signals, and validation values in this run are generated synthetic fixtures; not observed Bengaluru transactions.
unknown_market_policy: markets absent from training are mapped to a shared OOV node; graph profiles are fit on training-period rows only
graph_edge_type: top-5 covariate-profile similarity; not spatial adjacency
temporal_module: GRU over prior-quarter synthetic asking/guidance and declared/guidance summaries; current and future quarters are excluded from each row's history
model_description: Native PyTorch additive spline GAM hedonic head plus multi-head attention over training-profile-only functional micro-market similarity edges and a GRU over prior-quarter asking/guidance and declared/guidance summaries. Unseen markets map to a shared OOV node. Training combines interval-censored likelihood with generated exact-price anchors; inference uses a bounded truncated-lognormal posterior mean.

interpretation.hedonic_component: The network emits a unit-attribute log-price component.
interpretation.locality_premium: The network emits a graph/GRU log-price component; their sum is the latent log-price prior.
interpretation.asking_discount: A nonnegative asking markup fraction is learned from flagged synthetic anchors using asking/reference - 1 and unit, graph, and temporal context; each market-quarter estimate is aggregated from row predictions.
interpretation.underdeclaration_probability: A Bernoulli probability is learned from flagged synthetic anchors where the declared value is below generated reference price; each market-quarter estimate is aggregated from row predictions.

limitations: Synthetic fixture values are generated and cannot establish real-market accuracy or policy indices.

The graph has unit and training-known micro-market representations plus functional covariate-similarity edges; unseen markets map to an OOV node. No coordinates, POI nodes, RERA project nodes, metro-event edges, or true spatial-neighbor edges are available.
Functional profiles and profile scaling use training-period covariates only; markets absent from training use a shared OOV node.
Conformal strata are six functional market clusters built from synthetic property profiles because flagged anchors are too sparse per market; these are not geographic clusters.
Synthetic latent truth is used only on the final quarter to score the simulation and is never used to fit the model outside flagged synthetic anchors.
MugRep, ReGram, ST-RAP, LightGBM, and SHAP benchmarks are not run in this prototype; their packages or licensed data/implementations are not present.

five_seed_summary.prediction_aggregation: mean of five independently initialized BLP-Graph prediction vectors

hedonic_gam_ridge_anchor_proxy.description: Spline-feature Ridge hedonic proxy; generated anchor labels only.

hist_gradient_boosting_anchor_proxy.description: Histogram gradient boosting tabular proxy; not LightGBM, generated anchor labels only.

paired_wilcoxon_vs_geometric_pool.comparison: paired micro-market mean absolute percentage error: five-seed mean BLP-Graph vs naive geometric pool

leave_micro_market_out_evaluation.interpretation: Held-out markets are absent from fitted profiles and graph nodes; their rows map to the shared OOV node. Only their per-property input features are used at prediction time.

same_quarter_conformal_metrics_against_s.design: calibrate on flagged synthetic validation anchors from 2024Q1; score the remaining synthetic rows in 2024Q1
same_quarter_conformal_metrics_against_s.interpretation: same-quarter exchangeability demonstration only; does not validate next-quarter coverage

evaluation_protocols.chronological_holdout: Train 2023Q2-Q3; calibrate on flagged generated anchors in 2023Q4; evaluate on 2024Q1.
evaluation_protocols.leave_micro_market_out: Randomly select 20% of micro-market IDs; fit encoders, profiles, and graph only on the remaining training markets; map excluded markets to a shared OOV node; score their 2024Q1 records.
evaluation_protocols.conformal_strata: six functional market clusters (or fewer if the fixture has fewer market IDs), using generated calibration anchors
